Flat River.source: Safe Harbor Fishing / Fishbrain / Fox17 DNR electrofishing coverage
Flat River.notes: Safe Harbor Fishing lists bass, pike, walleye, panfish, catfish, bullhead, carp for the Flat River. Fishbrain catches and Fox17 DNR electrofishing confirm smallmouth. No dedicated DNR Status report found for the Flat River itself. URL: https://safeharborfishing.com/what-fish-are-in-the-flat-river

Pine River (Chippewa River tributary).source: Michigan DNR Status of the Fishery Resource Report 2015-201, Alma Impoundment
Pine River (Chippewa River tributary).notes: DNR report documents Upper Pine River/Alma Impoundment species. This covers the downstream impoundment, same river system. URL: https://www2.dnr.state.mi.us/publications/pdfs/DNRFishLibrary/StatusoftheFisheryResourceReports/0268_2015_AlmaImpoundment.pdf
